page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable, budget-friendly virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned for low-intensity workloads. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1161.28, while the multi-core score reached 2371.48, placing it in the lower performance tiers. Memory bandwidth tests show 187.49 GB/sec for small cached blocks, dropping to 22.38 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Geekbench results align with these findings, yielding a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0.

The burstable CPU allocation model makes this instance highly cost-efficient for workloads with variable CPU utilization. However, users must note the tradeoffs: sustained high CPU utilization will deplete CPU credits, and the baseline network bandwidth is minimal. Additionally, database operations and web serving throughput are limited, as shown by a Redis SET performance of 2.61 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 2.58 GB/sec.

This server is best suited for low-traffic web servers, development and testing environments, code repositories, and light background tasks that require occasional bursts of CPU performance rather than sustained high-compute power.
